about: Ratchet for src-tauri/src/osv/conformance_tests.rs: the values the Rust engine measures on the corpus, truncated to 4 decimals. Landed 2026-10-10 at #902 (W1-A); raised the same day by W1-F (Go: only modules whose selected version go.sum source-hashes; Gemfile.lock: GEM sections only, platform split as Bundler does; pnpm: an entry's own name/version fields; uv/poetry: VCS and URL sources are not index releases). The test fails if any falls; raise them in the PR that improves them. G1 target: findings precision >= 0.995 and recall >= 0.99 per ecosystem, max_silent_drops 0.
